newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia's Fischer dismisses leadership rumours.
newsitem.headline: Australia's Fischer dismisses leadership rumours.

text.p: Australian Deputy Prime Minister Tim Fischer on Monday rejected speculation over a possible challenge to Prime Minister John Howard, who is in hopital with pneumonia.
"It is the biggest load of garbage I have heard in months and should be regarded as such," Fischer told Australian Broadcasting Corp radio.
Howard's illness coincides with a mid-term slump in opinion polls for his Liberal-National government and his own popularity with voters.
The illness and the fall in popularity prompted media speculation of manoeuvring among potential leadership challengers Workplace Relations Minister Peter Reith and Treasurer Peter Costello.
